Metadata.description: Rent ready-made AI agents that get work done for you.

Home.title: AI agents that work for you
Home.subtitle: Choose an agent, describe the task, approve sensitive steps, and get the result.
Home.notConfiguredTitle: This installation is not configured yet
Home.notConfiguredBody: The administrator needs to complete the initial setup before the platform can be used.
Home.comingSoon: The agent catalog will be available soon.

Setup.title: Initial setup
Setup.intro: Configure the basic settings of this installation. You can change everything later in the admin panel.
Setup.tokenHint: Printed by the installer in the server terminal. Run "rentagent setup-token" to display it again.
Setup.siteNameHint: Shown to your users in the header, emails and browser tab.
Setup.timeZoneHint: IANA name, for example Asia/Jerusalem, Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.
Setup.baseCurrencyHint: ISO 4217 code, for example USD, EUR or ILS. Prices in other currencies can be added later.
Setup.licenseKeyHint: Optional for now. It can be added later.
Setup.mailIntro: Used for email verification, password resets and notifications. Recommended.
Setup.smtpPasswordHint: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.smtpFailed: Could not connect to the SMTP server. Check the details, or uncheck SMTP to configure it later.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Validation.invalidOption: Choose one of the available options.
Validation.invalidCurrency: Enter a valid ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD.
Validation.invalidTimeZone: Enter a valid IANA time zone, for example Europe/London.
Validation.invalidPort: Enter a port number between 1 and 65535.

Errors.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
Errors.errorBody: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

Legal.draftNotice: This page is a draft template. The operator of {siteName} must complete it and have it reviewed by a qualified professional before publication.
Legal.cookiesEssentialOnly: This site currently uses only essential cookies: session, security (CSRF), language preference and your cookie choices. They are required for the site to work and do not track you.
Legal.accessibilityCommitment: {siteName} aims to meet WCAG 2.1 level AA. If you encounter an accessibility barrier, please contact the site operator.

Consent.intro: Choose which optional cookies you allow. Essential cookies are always active because the site cannot work without them.
Consent.essentialBody: Session, security, language and consent preferences.
Consent.analyticsBody: Helps the operator understand how the site is used.
Consent.notInUse: Not currently in use on this site
Consent.bannerText: We use essential cookies to run this site and, with your permission, optional cookies for analytics and marketing.
